question: what exercises can I do without equipment
answer: You can do push-ups, squats, lunges, planks, jumping jacks, mountain climbers, and crunches without equipment.

question: best bodyweight exercises
answer: Some of the best bodyweight exercises are push-ups, squats, lunges, planks, and burpees.

question: how to build muscle without weights
answer: You can build muscle using bodyweight exercises by increasing repetitions, slowing down movements, and training consistently.

question: can I get fit with no equipment
answer: Yes, bodyweight workouts can help improve strength, endurance, and fitness without any equipment.

question: how to do a push up
answer: Start in a plank position, place your hands shoulder-width apart, lower your body until your chest is close to the floor, then push back up.

question: how to do a squat
answer: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, push your hips back, bend your knees, lower your body, then stand back up.

question: how to do a lunge
answer: Step one foot forward, lower your hips until both knees are bent, then push back to the starting position.

question: how to do a plank
answer: Place your forearms on the floor, keep your body straight from head to heels, and hold the position.

question: how to do jumping jacks
answer: Start standing, jump while spreading your legs and raising your arms, then jump back to the starting position.

question: how to do mountain climbers
answer: Start in a plank position and quickly bring one knee toward your chest, then switch legs repeatedly.

question: how to do crunches
answer: Lie on your back, bend your knees, lift your shoulders off the floor using your core, then slowly lower down.

question: how to do burpees
answer: Start standing, squat down, jump into a plank, do a push-up, jump back up, then jump vertically.

question: how many reps should I do for bodyweight exercises
answer: Beginners can start with 10 to 15 reps per exercise and increase gradually as strength improves.

question: how often should I do bodyweight workouts
answer: You can do bodyweight workouts 3 to 5 times per week, depending on your fitness level.

question: are bodyweight exercises good for beginners
answer: Yes, bodyweight exercises are safe, effective, and easy to modify for beginners.
